Exchange/platform: Gate
Headline: TRX ETF Trading Challenge: Unlock 3x Reward Points and Win Up to 500 USDT
Prize pool: 50K USDT
Start: 2026-11-27T08:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-03T08:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 500 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 10000 USDT (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
TRX ETF Trading Challenge is now live. During the campaign, trade any ETF to earn points and reach the required TRX ETF trading volume to unlock a points multiplier of up to 3x. As participants’ combined ETF trading volume reaches each milestone, a prize pool of up to 50,000 USDT will be unlocked. Share the unlocked prize pool based on your final points and win up to 500 USDT.
TRX ETF: TRX3L/3S、TRX5L/5S
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 27, 2026, 8:00 – December 3, 2026, 8:00 (UTC)
## Activity 1: Trade TRX ETF , Unlock Point Boost
During the campaign, trade any ETF to earn 1 base point for every 1,000 USDT in cumulative trading volume.
Reach the designated cumulative TRX ETF trading volume thresholds to unlock a Point Boost of up to 3x on points earned from other ETFs.
TRX ETF base points remain at 1x. The Point Boost applies only to points earned from other ETFs. Only the highest unlocked Point Boost applies, and Point Boosts are not cumulative.
Final Points = TRX ETF Base Points + Other ETF Base Points × Unlocked Point Boost
TRX ETF Trading Volume | Point Boost
≥ 10,000 USDT | 1.5x
≥ 30,000 USDT | 2x
≥ 60,000 USDT | 2.5x
≥ 100,000 USDT | 3x
## Activity 2: Unlock Tiered Prize Pools
During the campaign, participants can unlock tiered prize pools by reaching the required combined ETF trading volume milestones, with up to 50,000 USDT available.
Users will share the final unlocked prize pool in proportion to their share of the total final points, subject to the maximum reward per user for the applicable tier.
Combined ETF trading volume is calculated based on valid trading volume and is not affected by Point Boosts.
Total ETF Trading Volume | Unlocked Prize Pool | Max Reward per User
≥ 80,000,000 USDT | 10,000 USDT | 100 USDT
≥ 90,000,000 USDT | 20,000 USDT | 200 USDT
≥ 105,000,000 USDT | 35,000 USDT | 350 USDT
≥ 120,000,000 USDT | 50,000 USDT | 500 USDT
## Notes
Participants must click the "Join Now" button on the event page to register and complete identity verification to qualify for rewards.
During the event, users must select ETF trading pairs to trade. Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume.
Rewards will be distributed as USDT spot tokens to users’ accounts within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
The final prize pool for Activity 2 will be based on the highest milestone reached when the activity ends. Prize pool tiers are not cumulative.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In case of discrepancies between translated versions and the English version, the English version shall prevail. Gate reserves the final interpretation right of this event.
Users from the UK and other restricted regions may be unable to use part or all of the services (including participating in this event, games, or competitions). For detailed restricted region information, please refer to the User Agreement.
